main_text.p: que linea est velit una dictio. Sic & an-tiquissimi, & splendidissimi codices lati-ni.

Qui tamen ea legebant atque eti-amnum legunt, & periodos distinguunt, & accentus pronuntiant. Imo quæ natio, si Græcos excipias, nunc accentus scribit? Quæ tamen natio illos non pro-nuntiat? si versus inscripti erant, qua fronte Rab. Joseph in Talmude Tract. Kidusdum, cap. 1. f. 30. interrogat, ad quem versum pertineat, ריתולח[?] ad antecedentem aut subsequentem? Qua fronte respondeat, Abajeos non esse in-versibus numerandis exercitatos? Quid enim erat facilius codice sumpto inspi-cere notam Paulæ.

Nec difficile erat etiam puellis versus numerare, ad diju-dicandum, an ad priorem mediam par-tem, an ad posteriorem versus ille per-tineret. Noindum igitur inscripti erant versus textui, Deinde versus longe bre-viores distinguebant, quàm postea Ma-sorethæ.
Talmudici enim loco citato in lege numerant versus 8888[?] Masorethæ 5245, in Psalmis Talmudici 8896. Maso-

page.notes: Hebrew word after "pertineat," (ריתולח) is doubtful and copied as far as legible. The number "8888" before "Masorethæ" is printed in an old form and is doubtful. "Noindum" is copied as printed. "Kidusdum" is printed with long s. "cap. 1. f. 30." is read as printed, with the numeral doubtful. The running head is set in small capitals.
